description: Trigger + behavior evals for the dex2jar skills. Each eval names the skill it should route to and a realistic user prompt.

evals.prompt: I pulled this app.apk off a device and have no idea what it is — can you give me a quick rundown of what it is, who signed it, and whether anything looks sketchy?
evals.expected_output: Routes to apk-triage; runs manifest-inspect, apk-cert, native-libs, dex-strings and summarizes identity, attack surface, signer, native footprint, indicators, and a risk read.

evals.prompt: 这个 apk 安全吗？它申请了哪些权限，有没有导出的组件？
evals.expected_output: Routes to apk-triage; manifest-inspect -e surfaces permissions + exported components, flags debuggable/allowBackup.

evals.prompt: Where does this APK do its encryption, and who calls into the crypto routines?
evals.expected_output: Routes to sensitive-api-audit; dex-xref --preset crypto locates sinks, dex-method-trace --target traces callers back to entry points.

evals.prompt: 这个应用有没有动态加载代码或者用反射来藏行为？帮我查一下。
evals.expected_output: Routes to sensitive-api-audit; dex-xref --preset dynload and --preset reflection, corroborated with strings.

evals.prompt: Convert classes.dex to a jar I can open in a Java decompiler, and tell me if any methods didn't translate cleanly.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dex2jar; runs dex2jar then asm-verify, and explains DEX→JAR is lossy translation, flagging methods that fail verification.

evals.prompt: 把这个 apk 反编译看看它到底做了什么。
evals.expected_output: Routes to dex2jar; chooses triage-then-convert, references dex-to-jar-accuracy caveats and smali ground-truth.

evals.prompt: List the classes and methods in this dex and show me which other types each class depends on.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dex2jar; uses dex-inspect and dex-class-deps.
